heading: Hello, I’m Camilla.
lead: I’m the founder of Mills. With a background in theatre design, I’ve always been passionate about creating meaningful spaces with real impact.
text: I trained in professional interior design and started the studio to help people create homes that look wonderful and truly work for them.
